Build a single self-contained HTML page that recreates a dark "Agentic OS" command-centre dashboard, working from a written spec and reference screenshots.

READ FIRST, in this order:
1. `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/CommandCentre/reference/rubric-agentic-os/SPEC.md` — the complete spec. Every string, colour, panel, and interaction is in there.
2. These reference frames (use the Read tool — they render as images so you can actually see the design):
   - `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/CommandCentre/reference/rubric-agentic-os/frames/01-full-dashboard.jpg` — the whole layout
   - `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/CommandCentre/reference/rubric-agentic-os/frames/08-full-dashboard-clean.jpg` — same, cleaner
   - `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/CommandCentre/reference/rubric-agentic-os/frames/03-zoom-email-skills.jpg` — EMAIL + SKILLS DECK at readable size
   - `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/CommandCentre/reference/rubric-agentic-os/frames/05-zoom-routines-skillcards.jpg` — ROUTINES table + skill cards at readable size
   - `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/CommandCentre/reference/rubric-agentic-os/frames/06-model-effort-matrix.jpg` — the MODEL × EFFORT popover
   - `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/CommandCentre/reference/rubric-agentic-os/frames/09-ring-labels-search.jpg` — the artifacts ring with labels shown
   - `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/CommandCentre/reference/rubric-agentic-os/frames/10-artifact-modal.jpg` — the artifact detail modal
   - `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/CommandCentre/reference/rubric-agentic-os/frames/07-widget-edit-mode.jpg` — layout edit mode

The frames come from a screen recording; there is a presenter webcam box in the lower-left of every frame — that is NOT part of the UI, ignore it entirely.

WRITE THE RESULT TO EXACTLY THIS PATH (use the Write tool):
`/Users/kristinarash/DEV/CommandCentre/reference/rubric-agentic-os/agentic-os.html`

HARD CONSTRAINTS:
- ONE self-contained file: full `<!doctype html>` document with `<style>` and `<script>` inline. No build step. No external network requests at all — no CDN scripts, no Google Fonts. System font stack only.
- Vanilla JS. `<canvas>` for the particle core. The artifacts ring should be absolutely-positioned DOM elements or inline SVG so hover labels and click-to-open are straightforward.
- All demo data in a single `const DATA = {…}` object at the top of the script, so it is obvious where real data would be wired in later.
- Target viewport 1440×900, no page scroll at that size. Below ~1100px the rails may stack.
- Reproduce the demo data from the spec verbatim (the 47 emails, 170,000 subscribers, the seven routine rows, the four skill cards, etc.). Do not invent replacement data.

MAKE THESE INTERACTIONS ACTUALLY WORK — they are the point of the piece:
1. Live ticking clock in the CALENDAR panel plus the three timezone readouts.
2. Artifacts ring: hover a node → its label appears outside the ring on the correct side; click a node → the artifact modal opens with that node's data and dims the page behind it.
3. Skill card gear button → MODEL × EFFORT popover, with the violet pill row and draggable knob. Changing model or effort updates that card's `MODEL · EFFORT` line immediately.
4. Masthead pencil → layout edit mode: dashed orange outlines, corner handles, drag panels to move, resize by corner, persisted to localStorage.
5. Masthead magnifier → search that filters/dims ring nodes by label.
6. Particle core rotates slowly and continuously; clicking it shows a "SECOND BRAIN" state (a simple overlay panel is fine).

This is a design recreation and the bar is visual quality, not just structural completeness. Get the restraint right: near-black ground, hairline rules instead of heavy cards, uppercase letter-spaced panel titles, one orange accent used sparingly, generous negative space, quiet motion. Match the proportions in frame 01 — the ring should genuinely dominate the centre.

If a `design-taste`, `impeccable`, or `high-end-visual-design` skill is available to you, load it first.

Finish by writing the file. Do not stop at a plan or a summary. When the file is written, reply with just the path and a 3-line note on anything you deliberately simplified.

Base directory for this skill: /Users/kristinarash/.claude/skills/impeccable

This skill gives you the tools and permission to create design that earns to be called out-of-distribution craft: Whereas before, your design work would have been safe, timid and measured, you now approach every design task as a award-winning design director with impeccable understanding for what makes exceptional design work: production-grade code, peak creativity, a clear POV, deep understanding of the needs of the client and users, and exceptional craft.

Core principles:
- Go all out. No hedging, no shortcuts. The deliverable must be complete (except assets the user must provide).
- Dream big and bold. Distinct, beautiful, outstanding and highly inspiring work.
- Verify in bounded passes, not a loop, and the ceiling covers the whole cycle: screenshots, defect scans, micro-edits, and rebuilds alike. Build fully, inspect once with a batched round (desktop and mobile together), fix everything it shows in one batch, confirm with at most one more round, and stop polishing. Open-ended self-QA burns the user's money doing worse what the finish handoffs do better.

## Setup

1. Run `node .claude/skills/impeccable/scripts/context.mjs` once per session (if the runtime shows this skill's loaded base directory, run `node <skill-base-dir>/scripts/context.mjs`; keep cwd at the user's project). Pass a named source file or route as `--target <path>`. It loads PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, the matching surface brief, and native-platform guidance when applicable; follow its directives and do not rerun it.
2. Before acting, load the one playbook that owns the request: the Commands table's reference for an explicit or clearly implied sub-command, or [reference/new-work.md](reference/new-work.md) for a new surface or replacement visual world. Then inspect the target and at least one representative source of incumbent visual truth (tokens, theme, CSS, component, or asset) before editing.
3. After analysis and direction are resolved, load [reference/craft-floor.md](reference/craft-floor.md) immediately before editing UI. It carries the quality floor, the absolute bans, and the reflexes no detector catches. Do not load it for planning-only work.

## How to design

- **The brief wins.** Honor pinned aesthetics, eras, materials, fonts, and palettes even when they conflict with a saturated-pattern warning. Redirecting a clear brief toward your taste is failure.
- **Refinement preserves; redesign replaces.** Refinement keeps the incumbent identity, behavior, copy, and everything outside scope. Ask before replacing factual copy or adding claims. Redesign keeps product truth, content, function, native affordances, and constraints, but treats the old look as evidence and anti-reference; choose a replacement world in new-work and replace DESIGN.md. Never split the difference into polish on the discarded look.
- **Visual authority is evidence, not a filename.** Missing DESIGN.md alone does not make a project greenfield; new-work decides whether to preserve, expand, or replace the incumbent world.

## Modes

The mode names what the visitor's success looks like on this surface.

- **Persuade:** the visitor decides and acts; design is the product. Landing pages, marketing, campaigns, pricing. Earn attention and action. Ship real imagery when the brief needs it; follow the committed world, not category habit.
- **Operate:** the visitor completes a task. App UI, dashboards, editors, admin, settings, tools. Scanability, consistency, native expectations, and the real usage scene outrank expression. Brand lives in precise details.
- **Read:** the visitor understands something. Docs, articles, guides, help, changelogs. Structure for comprehension, then make the reading experience worth staying in.
- **Experience:** the visitor is inside the work itself. Portfolios, galleries, showcases. Let the artifact lead from the first viewport; the interface recedes.

Choose the mode from the requested surface, not the product, and persist it only in that surface brief. A tool's landing page is still Persuade; a fashion house's documentation is still Read; a docs index is Read, not Persuade. See [new-work.md](reference/new-work.md) for new surfaces and [operate.md](reference/operate.md) for deeper Operate/Read guidance.

## Commands

| Command | Category | Description | Reference |
|---|---|---|---|
| `craft [feature]` | Build | Deprecated alias for an ordinary new-work request | [reference/craft.md](reference/craft.md) |
| `shape [feature]` | Build | Plan UX/UI before writing code | [reference/shape.md](reference/shape.md) |
| `init` | Build | Capture durable product context in PRODUCT.md | [reference/init.md](reference/init.md) |
| `document` | Build | Generate DESIGN.md from existing project code | [reference/document.md](reference/document.md) |
| `extract [target]` | Build | Pull reusable tokens and components into design system | [reference/extract.md](reference/extract.md) |
| `critique [target]` | Evaluate | UX design review with heuristic scoring | [reference/critique.md](reference/critique.md) |
| `audit [target]` | Evaluate | Technical quality checks (a11y, perf, responsive) | [reference/audit.md](reference/audit.md) · native: [reference/audit.native.md](reference/audit.native.md) |
| `polish [target]` | Refine | Final quality pass before shipping | [reference/polish.md](reference/polish.md) |
| `bolder [target]` | Refine | Amplify safe or bland designs | [reference/bolder.md](reference/bolder.md) |
| `quieter [target]` | Refine | Tone down aggressive or overstimulating designs | [reference/quieter.md](reference/quieter.md) |
| `distill [target]` | Refine | Strip to essence, remove complexity | [reference/distill.md](reference/distill.md) |
| `harden [target]` | Refine | Production-ready: errors, i18n, edge cases | [reference/harden.md](reference/harden.md) |
| `onboard [target]` | Refine | Design first-run flows, empty states, activation | [reference/onboard.md](reference/onboard.md) |
| `animate [target]` | Enhance | Add purposeful animations and motion | [reference/animate.md](reference/animate.md) |
| `colorize [target]` | Enhance | Add strategic color to monochromatic UIs | [reference/colorize.md](reference/colorize.md) |
| `typeset [target]` | Enhance | Improve typography hierarchy and fonts | [reference/typeset.md](reference/typeset.md) |
| `layout [target]` | Enhance | Fix spacing, rhythm, and visual hierarchy | [reference/layout.md](reference/layout.md) |
| `delight [target]` | Enhance | Add personality and memorable touches | [reference/delight.md](reference/delight.md) |
| `overdrive [target]` | Enhance | Push past conventional limits | [reference/overdrive.md](reference/overdrive.md) |
| `clarify [target]` | Fix | Improve UX copy, labels, and error messages | [reference/clarify.md](reference/clarify.md) |
| `adapt [target]` | Fix | Adapt for different devices and screen sizes | [reference/adapt.md](reference/adapt.md) · native: [reference/adapt.native.md](reference/adapt.native.md) |
| `optimize [target]` | Fix | Diagnose and fix UI performance | [reference/optimize.md](reference/optimize.md) |
| `live` | Iterate | Visual variant mode: pick elements in the browser, generate alternatives | [reference/live.md](reference/live.md) |

Routing:

- **No argument:** read [routing.md](reference/routing.md) and present its context-aware menu; never auto-run a command.
- **Explicit or clearly implied command:** load its reference (native variant on native platforms) and follow it. Ask once if two commands fit.
- **Otherwise:** treat the request as general design work. Missing PRODUCT.md routes a new surface or replacement world through init, then new-work; a narrow refinement of existing code proceeds on the incumbent implementation as context.mjs directs, offering init afterward rather than blocking on it.
- `teach` aliases `init`. `craft` is a deprecated alias for ordinary new-work and adds nothing. `shape` owns task discovery, then enters new-work only for visual-world and surface-concept decisions.

After init writes PRODUCT.md, resume without rerunning `context.mjs`; init loads the native platform reference itself when the platform it recorded is `ios`, `android`, or `adaptive`.

**Pin / Unpin:** `node .claude/skills/impeccable/scripts/pin.mjs <pin|unpin> <command>` creates or removes a standalone `/<command>` shortcut. Report the script's result concisely; relay stderr verbatim on error.

**Hooks:** `/impeccable hooks <on|off|status|ignore-rule|ignore-file|ignore-value|reset>` manages the design detector hook for this project (auto-runs the detector after UI file edits and surfaces findings). Load [reference/hooks.md](reference/hooks.md) when the user invokes it with any argument.

**Doctor:** `/impeccable doctor` reports and repairs drift between this project's Impeccable artifacts (PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md and its sidecar, config, surface briefs, the hook) and what this version reads. Load [reference/doctor.md](reference/doctor.md) when the user invokes it, or when they ask what is out of date, stale, or needs refreshing. A `CONTEXT_STALE` directive in Setup's output is the cheap subset of the same report; act on it there per its own instructions rather than running doctor unasked.

**Never repair drift as a side effect of a design task.** A `CONTEXT_STALE` finding is reported, not acted on, unless the user asks. The one exception is a finding marked `auto`, which the next write to that file performs anyway.

# Craft floor

Load this after the direction is settled, and build without announcing the checklist. A pinned brief or the committed visual world overrides anything here; your own habit does not. When the design hook is active it already enforces the mechanical checks below as you edit: act on its findings instead of re-auditing each rule.

## Verify

Each of these is a check on the built result, not an intention. Run them together in the batched inspection rounds, not as separate screenshot trips; the checks share one render.

- **Contrast:** body and placeholder text ≥4.5:1, large text ≥3:1. On colored surfaces tint secondary text from that hue or the foreground; never gray.
- **Depth:** shadows carry an offset and a soft blur. A zero-offset colored halo is decoration.
- **Spacing:** tight groups, generous separation, more space above a heading than below it. Read the computed values.
- **Type:** body measure 65–75ch, display max 6rem, tracking floor -0.04em, balanced headings, obvious scale and weight steps. Run the real copy at every breakpoint and fix what overflows.
- **Motion:** one authored moment, not scattered effects and not one identical entrance on every section. Exponential ease-out from an already-visible default. Reach past transform and opacity: blur, backdrop-filter, clip-path, mask, and shadow belong to the palette when they stay smooth.
- **States:** hover, disabled, loading, error, empty. Plus real content, working controls, responsive composition, keyboard focus.
- **Copy:** the product's own language. Controls name their action; errors name the problem and the recovery.
- **Coverage:** every brief requirement present and findable within seconds.

## Refuse

These are the category's defaults, not bans: the brief's own words can earn any of them. Reaching for one when the axis is free means you were not deciding; recognizing that means rewriting the element, not softening it.

Page scaffolds:

- Same-size cards of icon plus heading plus text as the page structure. Cards are the lazy container; nested cards are always wrong.
- The hero-metric template: big number, small label, supporting stats, accent.
- A kicker or eyebrow above a heading. This one is a ban, not a default: no brief earns it back. The heading carries its own weight; delete the label and let the heading speak.
- Section numbers (01 / 02 / 03) unless the sequence itself carries information the reader needs.
- A modal for a task that needs neither interruption nor protected focus.

Surface habits:

- Gradient text. Emphasis comes from weight or size.
- Glass and blur as decoration rather than as a specific effect.
- A colored `border-left` or `border-right` above 1px on cards, list items, callouts, or alerts.
- Hard offset shadows (`box-shadow: 4px 4px 0`) outside a world that is actually neobrutalist. The zero-blur block shadow is a costume, not a depth system; a world that did not choose it never earns it as a default.
- Sparklines, progress rings, and soft-shadowed rounded rectangles standing in for content.
- Monospace as a costume for "technical" rather than for code, data, or measurement.
- A system display face (Impact, Arial Black, the platform sans) as the display voice of an own-world page. Source and self-host a face whose character matches the approved lettering; the closest installed font is a failure, not a fallback.
- Unicode glyphs or emoji standing in for an icon system. Icons are drawn, from a real library or authored SVG, in one consistent stroke and weight.
- Light or dark picked by category. Pick it from the use scene: who, where, under what ambient light.

The floor holds the mechanics; it never picks the direction. With every check green, spend the page on the committed world, and when torn between refined and committed, commit.

  /* ---------- micro apps ---------- */
  .apps{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
  .app{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:5px 4px 5px 0;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
  .app:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
  .app .tile{width:22px;height:22px;border:1px solid var(--hair-2);border-radius:4px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--sec);font-size:12px;flex:none}
  .app:hover .tile{color:var(--fg);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
  .app .txt{min-width:0}
  .app .name{font-size:12px;color:var(--fg);font-weight:500}
  .app .desc{font-size:9px;color:var(--dim);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .app .go{margin-left:auto;color:var(--dim);font-size:12px;transition:color .15s,transform .15s}
  .app:hover .go{color:var(--fg);transform:translateX(2px)}

  /* ---------- calendar ---------- */
  .cal-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .clock-face{width:46px;height:46px;flex:none}
  .cal-date{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .cal-time{font-size:27px;margin:1px 0 2px}
  .cal-zone{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
  .tz{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .tz .lab{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
  .tz .lab .ic{font-size:7px}
  .tz .val{font-size:10px;color:var(--fg);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
  .tz .val small{font-size:8px;color:var(--sec);letter-spacing:.06em}
  .yg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:16px 1fr;row-gap:4px;column-gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px;align-items:center}
  .yg .q{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--dim)}
  .yg .wk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(13,1fr);gap:3px;max-width:172px}
  .yg .w{height:8px;border-radius:1px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
  .yg .w.past{background:#8a8580;border-color:#8a8580}
  .yg .w.now{background:var(--acc);border-color:var(--acc)}
  .next-lab{margin-bottom:4px}
  .agenda{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
  .agenda .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:4px 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--fg)}
  .agenda .row .t{font-size:9px;color:var(--dim);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

  /* ---------- youtube ---------- */
  .yt-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px;margin-bottom:6px}
  .yt-num{font-size:30px}
  .yt-side{padding-bottom:3px;line-height:1.3}
  .yt-side .a{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg)}
  .yt-side .b{font-size:9px;color:var(--sec)}
  .dots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,14px);gap:8px 8px;margin:14px 0 18px}
  .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#2b2825;justify-self:center}
  .dot.on{background:var(--acc)}
  .dot.today{background:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--acc)}
  .sq-btn{width:20px;height:20px;border:1px solid var(--acc);border-radius:3px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--acc);font-size:10px;transition:background .15s,color .15s}
  .sq-btn:hover{background:var(--acc);color:#0a0a0a}

  /* ---------- masthead + centre ---------- */
  .centre{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;min-height:0}
  .mast{text-align:center;padding-top:26px;position:relative;z-index:3}
  .mast h1{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--fg);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;line-height:1}
  .mast h1 .ic{font-size:15px;color:var(--acc)}
  .mast h1 em{font-style:normal;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.01em;color:var(--acc)}
  .byline{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--sec);margin-top:6px}
  .tools{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
  .tools button{width:24px;height:24px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--sec);border-radius:3px;font-size:14px;transition:color .15s,background .15s}
  .tools button:hover{color:var(--fg);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
  .tools button.on{color:var(--acc)}
  .search{position:absolute;left:50%;top:100%;transform:translate(-50%,-2px);width:240px;display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair-2);z-index:4}
  .search.open{display:flex}
  .search .ic{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim)}
  .search input{flex:1;background:none;border:0;outline:0;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--fg)}
  .search input::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}
  .search .count{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

  .stage{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0}
  .ring{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
  .ring canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;transition:filter .3s}
  .core{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:240px;height:240px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer}
  .core .lbl{position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(50% + 118px);transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec);opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;white-space:nowrap}
  .core:hover .lbl{opacity:1}
  .ring.core-hot canvas{filter:brightness(1.18)}

  .node{position:absolute;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--ring);background:rgba(14,13,12,.75);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--sec);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,color .15s,transform .15s,opacity .25s;will-change:transform}
  .node .ic{font-size:16px}
  .node:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);color:var(--fg);transform:scale(1.08);z-index:5}
  .node.dim{opacity:.16}
  .node.gone{opacity:0;transform:scale(.4);pointer-events:none}
  .node .age{position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(100% - 5px);transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--sec);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--hair-2);border-radius:8px;padding:1px 5px;line-height:1.3}
  .label{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec);opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;pointer-events:none;max-width:170px}
  .label span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .label i{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc);flex:none}
  .node:hover .label,.ring.labels .node:not(.dim) .label{opacity:1}
  .label.r{left:calc(100% + 10px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%)}
  .label.l{right:calc(100% + 10px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);flex-direction:row-reverse}
  .label.t{bottom:calc(100% + 8px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
  .label.t.alt{bottom:calc(100% + 24px)}
  .label.b{top:calc(100% + 12px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);flex-direction:column-reverse;gap:3px}
  .label.b.alt{top:calc(100% + 28px)}

  /* ---------- email ---------- */
  .stat{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .stat .big{font-size:32px}
  .stat .side{line-height:1.3;padding-bottom:2px}
  .stat .side div{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec)}
  .stat .side div:first-child{color:var(--fg)}
  .mails{display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin:6px 0 12px}
  .mail{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:4px 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--fg)}
  .mail .ic{font-size:11px;color:var(--acc)}
  .mail .s{flex:1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .mail .age{font-size:9px;color:var(--dim);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .bar{display:flex;gap:2px;height:4px;margin:6px 0 6px}
  .bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:1px}
  .legend{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;margin-bottom:22px}
  .legend div{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);white-space:nowrap}
  .legend b{color:var(--fg);font-size:9px;margin-right:3px}
  .synced{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--dim)}
  .synced i{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc)}

  /* ---------- skills ---------- */
  .cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
  .card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:4px;padding:10px 10px 9px;position:relative}
  .card .ic{font-size:12px;color:var(--fg)}
  .card .nm{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--fg);margin-top:8px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .card .nm b{font-weight:400;color:rgba(232,98,42,.7)}
  .card .me{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-top:2px;white-space:nowrap}
  .card .me b{font-weight:600}
  .card .acts{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:10px}
  .run{width:20px;height:16px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--acc);color:#0a0a0a;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:9px;transition:filter .15s}
  .run:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
  .run .ic{color:#0a0a0a;font-size:9px}
  .gear{width:20px;height:16px;border-radius:3px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--sec);font-size:11px;transition:color .15s,background .15s}
  .gear:hover,.gear.on{color:var(--fg);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
  .gear .ic{color:inherit;font-size:11px}
  .m-opus{color:var(--opus)}.m-sonnet{color:var(--sonnet)}.m-haiku{color:var(--haiku)}.m-fable{color:var(--fable)}

  /* popover */
  .pop{position:fixed;z-index:60;width:344px;background:#121110;border:1px solid var(--hair-2);border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55);padding:14px 16px 16px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px);transition:opacity .18s,transform .18s;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
  .pop.show{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
  .pop-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec);margin-bottom:12px}
  .pop-hd .nm{color:var(--fg);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:.02em;font-size:11px;font-weight:500}
  .pop-hd .x{margin-left:auto;width:20px;height:20px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--sec);font-size:12px;border-radius:3px}
  .pop-hd .x:hover{color:var(--fg);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
  .mx{display:grid;grid-template-columns:62px repeat(5,46px)}
  .mx .h{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);text-align:center;padding:4px 0 8px}
  .mrow{display:contents}
  .mrow .rl{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec);display:flex;align-items:center;height:34px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s}
  .mrow.sel .rl{color:var(--opus)}
  .cell{height:34px;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;position:relative}
  .cell i{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:#3a3633;display:block;transition:background .15s,transform .15s}
  .cell:hover i{transform:scale(1.5);background:#6b6560}
  .cell.last i{width:5px;height:5px}
  .cell.last.haiku i{background:var(--haiku)}
  .cell.last.sonnet i{background:var(--sonnet)}
  .cell.last.fable i{background:var(--fable)}
  .cell.last.opus i{background:var(--opus)}
  .track{position:relative;grid-column:2 / span 5;height:0}
  .pillrow{position:absolute;left:11px;right:11px;top:-28px;height:22px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--violet);box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(124,92,230,.35);transition:top .18s}
  .knob{position:absolute;top:3px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4);cursor:grab;transition:left .12s}
  .knob:active{cursor:grabbing}
  .knob::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--violet)}
  .dragging .knob{transition:none}

  /* ---------- routines ---------- */
  .rt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr 46px;column-gap:8px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair)}
  .rt .c{text-align:right}
  .rt .m{text-align:center}
  .rbody{overflow-y:auto;max-height:190px;margin-top:4px;padding-right:2px}
  .rrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr 46px;column-gap:8px;align-items:center;height:26px;font-size:11px;color:var(--fg)}
  .rrow .time{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--sec);letter-spacing:.02em;width:40px;text-align:center;border-radius:2px;line-height:16px}
  .rrow .name{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0}
  .rrow .name span{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .host{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--dim);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;flex:none}
  .host .ic{font-size:7px}
  .rrow .st{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);text-align:right}
  .rrow.fired{opacity:.32}
  .rrow.next .time{background:var(--acc);color:#0a0a0a;font-weight:600;animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}
  .rrow.next .st{color:var(--acc)}
  @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(232,98,42,0)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(232,98,42,.22)}}
  .rfoot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:12px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
  .rfoot .hosts{display:flex;gap:12px}
  .rfoot .host{color:var(--sec);font-size:8px}

  /* ---------- modal / overlays ---------- */
  .veil{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(10,10,10,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .18s;display:grid;place-items:center}
  .veil.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
  .modal{width:344px;background:#141210;border:1px solid var(--acc);border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 10px 50px rgba(232,98,42,.22),0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);padding:16px 18px 16px;transform:translateY(4px);transition:transform .18s}
  .veil.show .modal{transform:none}
  .eyebrow{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(232,98,42,.75);margin-bottom:6px}
  .modal h2{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--fg);line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:8px}
  .modal p{font-size:10px;color:var(--sec);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:12px}
  .path{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;color:var(--fg);background:var(--inset);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:3px;padding:7px 9px;margin-bottom:14px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .btns{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
  .btn{font-size:8px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:background .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s}
  .btn.fill{background:var(--acc);color:#0a0a0a}
  .btn.fill:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}
  .btn.line{border:1px solid var(--acc);color:var(--acc)}
  .btn.line:hover{background:rgba(232,98,42,.12)}
  .btn.ghost{color:var(--sec);margin-left:auto}
  .btn.ghost:hover{color:var(--fg)}
  .modal.brain{width:380px;border-color:var(--hair-2);box-shadow:0 20px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
  .modal.brain .eyebrow{color:var(--sec)}
  .brain-map{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}
  .brain-map div{border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:3px;padding:8px 8px 7px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
  .brain-map .ic{font-size:12px;color:var(--fg)}

  /* ---------- edit mode ---------- */
  .dash.custom .panel{position:absolute;border:1px solid var(--hair)}
  .dash.custom .rail{border:0}
  .dash.editing .panel{outline:1px dashed var(--acc);outline-offset:-1px;user-select:none;z-index:6}
  .dash.editing .panel.lift{z-index:7}
  .grip{display:none;width:12px;height:14px;color:var(--acc);cursor:grab;margin-right:-2px;font-size:12px}
  .dash.editing .grip{display:grid;place-items:center}
  .dash.editing .panel-hd{cursor:grab}
  .hnd{position:absolute;width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--acc);z-index:8;display:none}
  .dash.editing .hnd{display:block}
  .hnd.nw{left:-1px;top:-1px;cursor:nwse-resize}.hnd.ne{right:-1px;top:-1px;cursor:nesw-resize}
  .hnd.sw{left:-1px;bottom:-1px;cursor:nesw-resize}.hnd.se{right:-1px;bottom:-1px;cursor:nwse-resize}
  .hnd.n{left:calc(50% - 3px);top:-1px;cursor:ns-resize}.hnd.s{left:calc(50% - 3px);bottom:-1px;cursor:ns-resize}
  .hnd.w{left:-1px;top:calc(50% - 3px);cursor:ew-resize}.hnd.e{right:-1px;top:calc(50% - 3px);cursor:ew-resize}
  .edit-bar{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:14px;z-index:70;display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .dash.editing ~ .edit-bar{display:flex}
  .edit-bar .reset{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
  .edit-bar .reset:hover{color:var(--fg)}
  .edit-bar .done{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc);color:#0a0a0a;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(232,98,42,.35)}
  .edit-bar .done .ic{color:#0a0a0a}

  /* ---------- responsive ---------- */
  @media (max-width:1100px){
    html,body{overflow:auto}
    .dash{display:block;height:auto}
    .dash .panel{position:static!important;left:auto!important;top:auto!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important}
    .rail.left,.rail.right{border:0}
    .centre{min-height:820px;border-top:1px solid var(--hair);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair)}
    .rail .panel:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair)}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="dash" id="dash">
  <aside class="rail left">
    <section class="panel" data-id="apps">
      <div class="panel-hd"><span class="grip" data-grip></span><span data-icon="grid"></span><span class="panel-title">Micro Apps</span>
        <div class="hd-right"><button class="pill">+ Add App</button></div></div>
      <div class="apps" id="apps"></div>
    </section>
    <section class="panel" data-id="calendar">
      <div class="panel-hd"><span class="grip" data-grip></span><span data-icon="calendar"></span><span class="panel-title">Calendar</span>
        <div class="hd-right"><span class="hint">Today</span><button class="pill ghost">Open Cal</button></div></div>
      <div class="cal-top">
        <svg class="clock-face" viewBox="0 0 46 46" fill="none">
          <circle cx="23" cy="23" r="21" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.22)" stroke-width="1"/>
          <g id="ticks" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.22)" stroke-width="1"></g>
          <line id="hh" x1="23" y1="23" x2="23" y2="12" stroke="#f2f0ed" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <line id="mh" x1="23" y1="23" x2="23" y2="7" stroke="#f2f0ed" stroke-width="1.1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <line id="sh" x1="23" y1="26" x2="23" y2="5" stroke="#e8622a" stroke-width=".8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <circle cx="23" cy="23" r="1.3" fill="#e8622a"/>
        </svg>
        <div>
          <div class="cal-date" id="calDate">Wk34 | Aug 20 2026 (Thu)</div>
          <div class="cal-time num" id="calTime">02:32:42 pm</div>
          <div class="cal-zone" id="calZone"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tz" id="tz"></div>
      <div class="yg" id="yg"></div>
      <div class="caps next-lab">What's next</div>
      <div class="agenda" id="agenda"></div>
    </section>
    <section class="panel" data-id="youtube">
      <div class="panel-hd"><span class="grip" data-grip></span><span data-icon="monitor"></span><span class="panel-title">YouTube Studio</span></div>
      <div class="yt-top">
        <div class="yt-num num" id="ytNum">0</div>
        <div class="yt-side"><div class="a">Subscribers</div><div class="b" id="ytViews"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="caps" id="ytLong"></div>
      <div class="dots" id="ytDots"></div>
      <button class="sq-btn" title="Open YouTube Studio"><span data-icon="external"></span></button>
    </section>
  </aside>

  <main class="centre">
    <header class="mast">
      <h1><span data-icon="hex"></span>RUBRIC <em id="brandSub">Agentic OS</em></h1>
      <div class="byline" id="byline"></div>

  .clock-face{width:46px;height:46px;flex:none}
  .cal-date{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .cal-time{font-size:27px;margin:1px 0 2px}
  .cal-zone{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
  .tz{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .tz .lab{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
  .tz .lab .ic{font-size:7px}
  .tz .val{font-size:10px;color:var(--fg);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
  .tz .val small{font-size:8px;color:var(--sec);letter-spacing:.06em}
  .yg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:16px 1fr;row-gap:4px;column-gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px;align-items:center}
  .yg .q{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--dim)}
  .yg .wk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(13,1fr);gap:3px;max-width:172px}
  .yg .w{height:8px;border-radius:1px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
  .yg .w.past{background:#8a8580;border-color:#8a8580}
  .yg .w.now{background:var(--acc);border-color:var(--acc)}
  .next-lab{margin-bottom:4px}
  .agenda{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
  .agenda .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:4px 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--fg)}
  .agenda .row .t{font-size:9px;color:var(--dim);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

  /* ---------- youtube ---------- */
  .yt-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px;margin-bottom:6px}
  .yt-num{font-size:30px}
  .yt-side{padding-bottom:3px;line-height:1.3}
  .yt-side .a{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg)}
  .yt-side .b{font-size:9px;color:var(--sec)}
  .dots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,14px);gap:8px 8px;margin:14px 0 18px}
  .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#2b2825;justify-self:center}
  .dot.on{background:var(--acc)}
  .dot.today{background:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--acc)}
  .sq-btn{width:20px;height:20px;border:1px solid var(--acc);border-radius:3px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--acc);font-size:10px;transition:background .15s,color .15s}
  .sq-btn:hover{background:var(--acc);color:#0a0a0a}

  /* ---------- masthead + centre ---------- */
  .centre{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;min-height:0}
  .mast{text-align:center;padding-top:26px;position:relative;z-index:3}
  .mast h1{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--fg);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;line-height:1}
  .mast h1 .ic{font-size:15px;color:var(--acc)}
  .mast h1 em{font-style:normal;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.01em;color:var(--acc)}
  .byline{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--sec);margin-top:6px}
  .tools{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
  .tools button{width:24px;height:24px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--sec);border-radius:3px;font-size:14px;transition:color .15s,background .15s}
  .tools button:hover{color:var(--fg);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
  .tools button.on{color:var(--acc)}
  .search{position:absolute;left:50%;top:100%;transform:translate(-50%,-2px);width:240px;display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair-2);z-index:4}
  .search.open{display:flex}
  .search .ic{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim)}
  .search input{flex:1;background:none;border:0;outline:0;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--fg)}
  .search input::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}
  .search .count{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

  .stage{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0}
  .ring{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
  .ring canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;transition:filter .3s}
  .core{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:240px;height:240px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer}
  .core .lbl{position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(50% + 118px);transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec);opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;white-space:nowrap}
  .core:hover .lbl{opacity:1}
  .ring.core-hot canvas{filter:brightness(1.18)}

  .node{position:absolute;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--ring);background:rgba(14,13,12,.75);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--sec);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,color .15s,transform .15s,opacity .25s;will-change:transform}
  .node .ic{font-size:16px}
  .node:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);color:var(--fg);transform:scale(1.08);z-index:5}
  .node.dim{opacity:.16}
  .node.gone{opacity:0;transform:scale(.4);pointer-events:none}
  .node .age{position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(100% - 5px);transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--sec);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--hair-2);border-radius:8px;padding:1px 5px;line-height:1.3}
  .label{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec);opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;pointer-events:none;max-width:170px}
  .label span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .label i{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc);flex:none}
  .node:hover .label,.ring.labels .node:not(.dim) .label{opacity:1}
  .label.r{left:calc(100% + 10px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%)}
  .label.l{right:calc(100% + 10px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);flex-direction:row-reverse}
  .label.t{bottom:calc(100% + 8px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
  .label.t.alt{bottom:calc(100% + 24px)}
  .label.b{top:calc(100% + 12px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);flex-direction:column-reverse;gap:3px}
  .label.b.alt{top:calc(100% + 28px)}

  /* ---------- email ---------- */
  .stat{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .stat .big{font-size:32px}
  .stat .side{line-height:1.3;padding-bottom:2px}
  .stat .side div{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec)}
  .stat .side div:first-child{color:var(--fg)}
  .mails{display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin:6px 0 12px}
  .mail{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:4px 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--fg)}
  .mail .ic{font-size:11px;color:var(--acc)}
  .mail .s{flex:1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .mail .age{font-size:9px;color:var(--dim);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .bar{display:flex;gap:2px;height:4px;margin:6px 0 6px}
  .bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:1px}
  .legend{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;margin-bottom:22px}
  .legend div{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);white-space:nowrap}
  .legend b{color:var(--fg);font-size:9px;margin-right:3px}
  .synced{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--dim)}
  .synced i{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc)}

  /* ---------- skills ---------- */
  .cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
  .card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:4px;padding:10px 10px 9px;position:relative}
  .card .ic{font-size:12px;color:var(--fg)}
  .card .nm{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--fg);margin-top:8px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .card .nm b{font-weight:400;color:rgba(232,98,42,.7)}
  .card .me{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-top:2px;white-space:nowrap}
  .card .me b{font-weight:600}
  .card .acts{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:10px}
  .run{width:20px;height:16px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--acc);color:#0a0a0a;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:9px;transition:filter .15s}
  .run:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
  .run .ic{color:#0a0a0a;font-size:9px}
  .gear{width:20px;height:16px;border-radius:3px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--sec);font-size:11px;transition:color .15s,background .15s}
  .gear:hover,.gear.on{color:var(--fg);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
  .gear .ic{color:inherit;font-size:11px}
  .m-opus{color:var(--opus)}.m-sonnet{color:var(--sonnet)}.m-haiku{color:var(--haiku)}.m-fable{color:var(--fable)}

  /* popover */
  .pop{position:fixed;z-index:60;width:344px;background:#121110;border:1px solid var(--hair-2);border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55);padding:14px 16px 16px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px);transition:opacity .18s,transform .18s;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
  .pop.show{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
  .pop-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec);margin-bottom:12px}
  .pop-hd .nm{color:var(--fg);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:.02em;font-size:11px;font-weight:500}
  .pop-hd .x{margin-left:auto;width:20px;height:20px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--sec);font-size:12px;border-radius:3px}
  .pop-hd .x:hover{color:var(--fg);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
  .mx{display:grid;grid-template-columns:62px repeat(5,46px)}
  .mx .h{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);text-align:center;padding:4px 0 8px}
  .mrow{display:contents}
  .mrow .rl{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec);display:flex;align-items:center;height:34px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s}
  .mrow.sel .rl{color:var(--opus)}
  .cell{height:34px;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;position:relative}
  .cell i{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:#3a3633;display:block;transition:background .15s,transform .15s}
  .cell:hover i{transform:scale(1.5);background:#6b6560}
  .cell.last i{width:5px;height:5px}
  .cell.last.haiku i{background:var(--haiku)}
  .cell.last.sonnet i{background:var(--sonnet)}
  .cell.last.fable i{background:var(--fable)}
  .cell.last.opus i{background:var(--opus)}
  .track{position:relative;grid-column:2 / span 5;height:0}
  .pillrow{position:absolute;left:11px;right:11px;top:-28px;height:22px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--violet);box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(124,92,230,.35);transition:top .18s}
  .knob{position:absolute;top:3px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4);cursor:grab;transition:left .12s}
  .knob:active{cursor:grabbing}
  .knob::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--violet)}
  .dragging .knob{transition:none}

  /* ---------- routines ---------- */
  .rt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr 46px;column-gap:8px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair)}
  .rt .c{text-align:right}
  .rt .m{text-align:center}
  .rbody{overflow-y:auto;max-height:190px;margin-top:4px;padding-right:2px}
  .rrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr 46px;column-gap:8px;align-items:center;height:26px;font-size:11px;color:var(--fg)}
  .rrow .time{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--sec);letter-spacing:.02em;width:40px;text-align:center;border-radius:2px;line-height:16px}
  .rrow .name{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0}
  .rrow .name span{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .host{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--dim);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;flex:none}
  .host .ic{font-size:7px}
  .rrow .st{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);text-align:right}
  .rrow.fired{opacity:.32}
  .rrow.next .time{background:var(--acc);color:#0a0a0a;font-weight:600;animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}
  .rrow.next .st{color:var(--acc)}
  @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(232,98,42,0)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(232,98,42,.22)}}
  .rfoot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:12px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
  .rfoot .hosts{display:flex;gap:12px}
  .rfoot .host{color:var(--sec);font-size:8px}

  /* ---------- modal / overlays ---------- */
  .veil{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(10,10,10,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .18s;display:grid;place-items:center}
  .veil.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
  .modal{width:344px;background:#141210;border:1px solid var(--acc);border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 10px 50px rgba(232,98,42,.22),0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);padding:16px 18px 16px;transform:translateY(4px);transition:transform .18s}
  .veil.show .modal{transform:none}
  .eyebrow{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(232,98,42,.75);margin-bottom:6px}
  .modal h2{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--fg);line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:8px}
  .modal p{font-size:10px;color:var(--sec);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:12px}
  .path{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;color:var(--fg);background:var(--inset);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:3px;padding:7px 9px;margin-bottom:14px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .btns{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
  .btn{font-size:8px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:background .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s}
  .btn.fill{background:var(--acc);color:#0a0a0a}
  .btn.fill:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}
  .btn.line{border:1px solid var(--acc);color:var(--acc)}
  .btn.line:hover{background:rgba(232,98,42,.12)}
  .btn.ghost{color:var(--sec);margin-left:auto}
  .btn.ghost:hover{color:var(--fg)}
  .modal.brain{width:380px;border-color:var(--hair-2);box-shadow:0 20px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
  .modal.brain .eyebrow{color:var(--sec)}
  .brain-map{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}
  .brain-map div{border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:3px;padding:8px 8px 7px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sec);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
  .brain-map .ic{font-size:12px;color:var(--fg)}

  /* ---------- edit mode ---------- */
  .dash.custom .panel{position:absolute;border:1px solid var(--hair)}
  .dash.custom .rail{border:0}
  .dash.editing .panel{outline:1px dashed var(--acc);outline-offset:-1px;user-select:none;z-index:6}
  .dash.editing .panel.lift{z-index:7}
  .grip{display:none;width:12px;height:14px;color:var(--acc);cursor:grab;margin-right:-2px;font-size:12px}
  .dash.editing .grip{display:grid;place-items:center}
  .dash.editing .panel-hd{cursor:grab}
  .hnd{position:absolute;width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--acc);z-index:8;display:none}
  .dash.editing .hnd{display:block}
  .hnd.nw{left:-1px;top:-1px;cursor:nwse-resize}.hnd.ne{right:-1px;top:-1px;cursor:nesw-resize}
  .hnd.sw{left:-1px;bottom:-1px;cursor:nesw-resize}.hnd.se{right:-1px;bottom:-1px;cursor:nwse-resize}
  .hnd.n{left:calc(50% - 3px);top:-1px;cursor:ns-resize}.hnd.s{left:calc(50% - 3px);bottom:-1px;cursor:ns-resize}
  .hnd.w{left:-1px;top:calc(50% - 3px);cursor:ew-resize}.hnd.e{right:-1px;top:calc(50% - 3px);cursor:ew-resize}
  .edit-bar{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:14px;z-index:70;display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .dash.editing ~ .edit-bar{display:flex}
  .edit-bar .reset{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
  .edit-bar .reset:hover{color:var(--fg)}
  .edit-bar .done{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc);color:#0a0a0a;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(232,98,42,.35)}
  .edit-bar .done .ic{color:#0a0a0a}

  /* ---------- responsive ---------- */
  @media (max-width:1100px){
    html,body{overflow:auto}
    .dash{display:block;height:auto}
    .dash .panel{position:static!important;left:auto!important;top:auto!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important}
    .rail.left,.rail.right{border:0}
    .centre{min-height:820px;border-top:1px solid var(--hair);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair)}
    .rail .panel:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair)}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="dash" id="dash">
  <aside class="rail left">
    <section class="panel" data-id="apps">
      <div class="panel-hd"><span class="grip" data-grip></span><span data-icon="grid"></span><span class="panel-title">Micro Apps</span>
        <div class="hd-right"><button class="pill">+ Add App</button></div></div>
      <div class="apps" id="apps"></div>
    </section>
    <section class="panel" data-id="calendar">
      <div class="panel-hd"><span class="grip" data-grip></span><span data-icon="calendar"></span><span class="panel-title">Calendar</span>
        <div class="hd-right"><span class="hint">Today</span><button class="pill ghost">Open Cal</button></div></div>
      <div class="cal-top">
        <svg class="clock-face" viewBox="0 0 46 46" fill="none">
          <circle cx="23" cy="23" r="21" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.22)" stroke-width="1"/>
          <g id="ticks" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.22)" stroke-width="1"></g>
          <line id="hh" x1="23" y1="23" x2="23" y2="12" stroke="#f2f0ed" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <line id="mh" x1="23" y1="23" x2="23" y2="7" stroke="#f2f0ed" stroke-width="1.1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <line id="sh" x1="23" y1="26" x2="23" y2="5" stroke="#e8622a" stroke-width=".8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <circle cx="23" cy="23" r="1.3" fill="#e8622a"/>
        </svg>
        <div>
          <div class="cal-date" id="calDate">Wk34 | Aug 20 2026 (Thu)</div>
          <div class="cal-time num" id="calTime">02:32:42 pm</div>
          <div class="cal-zone" id="calZone"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tz" id="tz"></div>
      <div class="yg" id="yg"></div>
      <div class="caps next-lab">What's next</div>
      <div class="agenda" id="agenda"></div>
    </section>
    <section class="panel" data-id="youtube">
      <div class="panel-hd"><span class="grip" data-grip></span><span data-icon="monitor"></span><span class="panel-title">YouTube Studio</span></div>
      <div class="yt-top">
        <div class="yt-num num" id="ytNum">0</div>
        <div class="yt-side"><div class="a">Subscribers</div><div class="b" id="ytViews"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="caps" id="ytLong"></div>
      <div class="dots" id="ytDots"></div>
      <button class="sq-btn" title="Open YouTube Studio"><span data-icon="external"></span></button>
    </section>
  </aside>

  <main class="centre">
    <header class="mast">
      <h1><span data-icon="hex"></span>RUBRIC <em id="brandSub">Agentic OS</em></h1>
      <div class="byline" id="byline"></div>
      <div class="tools">
        <button id="btnEdit" title="Edit layout"><span data-icon="pencil"></span></button>
        <button id="btnSearch" title="Search artifacts"><span data-icon="search"></span></button>
        <button id="btnLayout" title="Layout"><span data-icon="layout"></span></button>
        <button id="btnInfo" title="About"><span data-icon="info"></span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="search" id="search"><span data-icon="search"></span><input id="q" placeholder="filter artifacts" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"><span class="count" id="qCount"></span></div>
    </header>
    <div class="stage" id="stage">
      <div class="ring" id="ring">
        <canvas id="core"></canvas>
        <div class="core" id="coreHit"><div class="lbl">Second Brain</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>

  <aside class="rail right">
    <section class="panel" data-id="email">

**Live dashboard:** `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/CommandCentre/os.html`

Verified against the live server's `/api/state.json` at 1440×900 (Playwright + Chrome): no page scroll, no console errors, zero non-origin requests, 40 ring nodes, 148 skill cards, health rows expand to mono detail, modal's OPEN FILE is a real `/open?f=…` link with `target=_blank`, skill/ring filters work, edit mode saves to `keystone.layout.v1`, and an aborted fetch renders the dim "cannot reach /api/state.json" state with dashes instead of zeros.

Compromises, by panel:
- **Note for the coordinator:** the test server returns 404 for `/os.html`, so I verified by loading the file directly and proxying only `/api/state.json` to `127.0.0.1:7374`. The page itself uses the relative path with no host or port; it just needs the server to serve the file.
- **PROJECTS:** the list is capped at ~8 visible rows (scrolls) so the Skills Deck keeps enough height for its cards. Rank, name and `[stage]` are parsed from the detail lines; any line that doesn't match falls back to the raw mono string.
- **SKILLS DECK:** no run button, no model×effort matrix; the gear is gone entirely. Clicking a card opens the old popover shape showing the full description and the skill directory. Descriptions arrive with a leading `"` which I strip for display.
- **Ring:** node icons are chosen by `kind` (pdf → document) and, for html, by a hash of `project` so each project gets a consistent glyph; they carry no other meaning. Age badges show whatever `age` string the API sends (currently `2D`, `14H`, `3M`).
- **SYSTEM HEALTH:** long `head` strings (e.g. Backup) are ellipsised in the row and repeated as the first line of the expanded detail. The clock is local time only; no timezone strip.
- **Routines:** `IDLE` and `QUEUED` are styled the same (dim); `pid` shows as a tiny mono chip, and a non-zero `exit` would show as `exit N` in the same slot.
